We have installation guide:
## How to build
To build developer portal locally yarn recommended.
### Preconditions
To install yarn: npm install --global yarn
Before proceeding double check yarn installed: yarn --version
### Environment Variables
App uses env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN default docs.fitko.de, NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_ANALYTICS_URL default https://plausible.io/docs.fitko.de
Override create .env.local root:
# .env.local
NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN=your-domain.com
NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_ANALYTICS_URL=https://plausible.io/your-domain.com
### Start development environment
yarn install
yarn dev
By default server runs on localhost:3000
### Production build
yarn install
yarn export
Result stored in build directory.
